title: Membership in the nonempty low-degree family
statement: Let $f$ be a Boolean function on the $n$-dimensional sign cube, and let $S$ be a subset of its coordinates. Then $S$ belongs to the family associated with $f$ exactly when $S$ is a nonempty subset of the Friedgut coordinates of $f$ at parameter $1/8$, and its cardinality is at most the Friedgut degree of $f$ at parameter $1/8$.
hypotheses_covered: Boolean function $f$ on the sign cube of dimension $n$
